news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Steel Hub Ka Vikaas: 51600 Karod Rupye Ka Nivesh
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain
Is naye steel hub ke vikaas se Bihar mein 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga
Yeh pariyojna Bihar ko steel utpaadan mein aage badhane mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Bihar Sarkar Ki 100 Din Puri: Vikas Yojanaon Par Hui Charcha
bullets: Bihar sarkar ki 100 din puri hone par vibhinn jagahon par rajya star par prasaran hua
Is prasaran mein vikas yojanaon par vistar se charcha hui
Bihar sarkar ne apni 100 din ki uplabdhiyon ko jan-jan tak pahunchane ka prayaas kiya hai

news_cards.title: Mukhyamantri Ne JP Ganga Path Ko Vishwashtareya Swaroop Dene Ke Diye Nirdesh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga path ko vishwashtareya swaroop dene ke liye nirdesh diya hai
Is pariyojna se 65 kilometer ganga channel ka vikaas hoga
Yeh pariyojna Bihar ke aarthik vikaas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayegi

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Textile Aur Nuclear Energy Sector Ka Vikaas
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne naye textile aur nuclear energy sector ke vikaas ke liye yojana banayi hai
Is yojana se Bihar mein naye rojgar ke avsar paida honge
Yeh pariyojna Bihar ke aarthik vikaas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayegi

news_cards.title: Mukhyamantri Ne Nasarigunj-Panapur Nishulk Steamer Ferry Seva Ka Kiya Shubharambh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Nasarigunj-Panapur nishulk steamer ferry seva ka shubharambh kiya hai
Is seva se logon ko safar karne mein aasani hogi
Yeh pariyojna Bihar ke logon ke liye mahatvapoorn sahyog sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Mahashakti Group Ke Saath MoU Par Hastakshar
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne Mahashakti group ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain
Is MoU ke tahat 6 hazar karod rupye ka nivesh hoga

news_cards.title: Mukhyamantri Ne Rera Ki Karyapranali Ko Pardarshi Banane Ke Diye Nirdesh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Rera ki karyapranali ko pardarshi banane ke liye nirdesh diya hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Co-Operative Bank Ki Karyapranali Ko Adhik Prabhavi Banane Ke Liye Nirdesh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne naye co-operative bank ki karyapranali ko adhik prabhavi banane ke liye nirdesh diya hai
